pluginDetailEmptyDesc: This image has no plugin metadata, or the plugin does not provide a detail template.
imageDetailFieldsToggle: Show or hide basic image information
scrollTooFast4: Give the frame rate a break~
scrollTooFast5: Like a rocket! Wait for me~
dedupeDesc: Remove identical images (does not delete files)
dedupeDescDesktop: Remove images with identical hash in database
removeMissingDesc: Remove images whose source file no longer exists
removeMissingDescDesktop: Remove images whose source file no longer exists in database
removeUnrecognizedDesc: Remove records when the file still exists on disk but its extension or type is not recognized as a supported image or video
removeUnrecognizedDescDesktop: Remove records whose local file exists but is not recognized as supported media
removeUnrecognizedSlowHint: Note: this reads each file to detect type and will significantly slow down organizing.
organizeRangeDesc: The gallery has {total} images. Drag to choose the index range to process in this run (minimum span 1000)
regenThumbnailsDesc: Regenerate missing thumbnails. On Linux CEF, legacy MP4 video thumbnails are regenerated as VP9 WebM.
imageOriginalMissingWarning: This image file cannot be found.
imageThumbnailMissingWarning: The thumbnail failed to load, but the original file still exists. Open Organize, enable "Regenerate thumbnails", then run it again. Suggested range: {range} (image ID: {id}).
imageThumbnailMissingWarningNoRange: The thumbnail failed to load, but the original file still exists. Open Organize, enable "Regenerate thumbnails", then run it again. Image ID: {id}.
imageCompatibleMissingWarning: The browser-compatible copy failed to load; fell back to the original file. You can regenerate it in Organize.
regenCompatibleDesc: Generate browser-compatible copies. On Linux CEF, all videos are converted to VP9/Opus WebM; other platforms convert media the WebView cannot display natively (WMV, HEVC, MKV, oversized images, etc.).
regenCompatibleSlowHint: Note: requires per-file decode and transcode — may take a long time.
organizeBackfillNativeMetadataDesc: Compute embedded metadata for JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF images with missing or outdated results. Images with identical content share results automatically.
organizeBackfillNativeMetadataDescDeskto: Compute embedded metadata for JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF images with missing or outdated results. Images with identical content share results automatically.
organizeBackfillNativeMetadataSlowHint: Note: files must be read one by one, so organizing will take longer.
deleteSourceFiles: Also move source files to Trash
deleteSourceFilesDesc: After removing database records, move the corresponding files to the system Trash (recoverable, never permanently deleted). Files on symlinks, network shares, or virtual drives are only removed from the library and kept on disk.
deleteSourceFilesDescDesktop: Applies only to images removed in this run; files are moved to the system Trash (recoverable). Files on symlinks/network/virtual drives are only removed from the library, not deleted from disk.
byWallpaperSetAsc: By last set as wallpaper (oldest first)
byWallpaperSetDesc: By last set as wallpaper (newest first)
wallpaperOrderEmptyTip: No image has been set as desktop wallpaper yet.
galleryPathLoadFailedClearFilters: The current path failed to load. All filters and search have been cleared automatically.
selectImageDesc: Select one or more images from gallery
selectVideoDesc: Select one or more videos from gallery
localDesc: Import from local: images, videos or folders
remoteDesc: Use plugins to collect images from network
organizeNoNewDownloadHint: No newly downloaded items are added during organizing. Progress only reflects the scope captured when this run started.
organizeDone: Organize done: removed {removed} images, regenerated {regenerated} thumbnails
removeDialogCheckboxLabel: Also move image files to Trash
removeDialogDangerText: Files will be moved to the system Trash (recoverable) and removed from all albums and gallery. Files on symlinks/network/virtual drives are only removed from the library, not deleted from disk.
removeDialogSafeText: If unchecked, images are only removed from this album; files and entries in other albums are kept.
removeDialogMessageSingle: This image will be removed from the current album.
removeDialogMessageMulti: These {count} images will be removed from the current album.
deleteDialogMessageSingle: This image file will be moved to the system Trash (recoverable) and removed from all albums and gallery. Files on symlinks/network/virtual drives are only removed from the library, not deleted from disk.
deleteDialogMessageMulti: These {count} image files will be moved to the system Trash (recoverable) and removed from all albums and gallery. Files on symlinks/network/virtual drives are only removed from the library, not deleted from disk.
removeDialogWallpaperHint: Note: Selection includes the current wallpaper. Remove/delete will not change the desktop wallpaper immediately, but it will not be available after next launch.
deletedAndRemovedSuccess: Deleted (removed from all albums and gallery)
deletedAndRemovedCountSuccess: Deleted {count} images (removed from all albums and gallery)
removeFromGalleryMessageSingle: This image will be removed and its local file moved to the system Trash (recoverable). Files on symlinks/network/virtual drives are only removed from the library. Use "Hide" if you want to keep it in the library.
removeFromGalleryMessageMulti: These {count} images will be removed and their local files moved to the system Trash (recoverable). Files on symlinks/network/virtual drives are only removed from the library. Use "Hide" if you want to keep them in the library.
nativeMetaEmptyJpeg: Images crawled from the web are usually stripped of EXIF by the platform — this is common and expected, not an error.
nativeMetaEmptyPng: This PNG carries no tEXt / iTXt text chunks, which is perfectly normal.
nativeMetaEmptyWebp: This WebP uses the simple format, which structurally has nowhere to store EXIF / XMP. This is perfectly normal.
nativeMetaEmptyGif: GIF does not support EXIF, and this file carries no comment block either. This is perfectly normal.
nativeMetaErrorDesc: The file may be corrupted, moved, or deleted. Check that the local file still exists.
nativeMetaPartialWarning: Some data blocks are corrupted; showing only the parts that parsed successfully.
nativeMetaGpsPrivacy: This image contains a GPS location. Sharing the original will also expose where it was taken.
hiddenCleanupConfirm: This permanently removes {count} hidden images from the library and deletes their source files (moved to the system trash on desktop). This cannot be undone. Continue?
hiddenCleanupDonePartial: Cleanup finished: removed {removed}, but {kept} source files could not be deleted and are still in place
advancedQueryDropped: The advanced query uses OR/NOT, which simple filters cannot express — it has been cleared.
advancedIntro: Each condition row is a complete gallery filter. Dimensions in a row all apply; unselected dimensions match any value.
searchModeHelpMetadata: Searches normalized titles, authors, and tags.
searchModeHelpNativeMetadata: Searches fields saved verbatim by plugins.
advancedPluginExtendRestricted: Plugin subfilters cannot be used in OR groups or negated conditions. Only the plugin was kept.
pathqlHelp: PathQL is Kabegame's own query path: one path is one filter — copy, share, or paste it back to reproduce the result.
advancedSimpleFilterDisabled: Advanced query is active; simple and advanced filters are mutually exclusive
